entry.content:
Tama is a ninja who speaks in the third person, hates wearing clothes, and considers her pet boar Jiggle a tactical asset. She is also, apparently, the lost princess of a kingdom she has never heard of and the living avatar of the Goddess of Creation. She would rather fight goblins. Saki is a Kitsune who has spent her entire life manipulating everyone around her. She thought she was beyond caring about anyone. Then she met Tama. Together, an illiterate cat-girl and a traumatized fox-girl stumble through goblin armies, undead liches, and ancient dragons. Then discover that the hardest enemy to defeat is paperwork. Along the way they will collect a divine water spirit who wants to be a pet, an elf child who wants to be a weapon, and a princess who wants to be a slave. Her Majesty, Tamaneko is a progression fantasy about found family, the cost of strength, and learning that sometimes the person you needed was already looking for you.

Platforms: Gumroad · Kindle

entry.content:
Lucas the Grand Strategist is the most feared adventurer in the kingdom. He defeated an ancient dragon on his first day, cleared eighty goblins in a single afternoon, and dismantled an entire bandit operation without breaking a sweat. None of that is true. He tripped, panicked, and got lucky. Repeatedly. The dragon died because he fell down. The goblins died because he ran in circles. The bandits died because he threw something out of spite and didn't know what it was. Unfortunately nobody believes him. Not the elf ranger who has decided she is on a grand romantic adventure with a tactical genius. Not the Nekojin who keeps showing up in his room at night, who he is absolutely certain is an assassin. Not the adventurers guild who keeps giving him quests he doesn't understand. And certainly not the Demon Queen, who will one day face him in single combat and lose in a way she will never be able to adequately explain. Lucas just wants to survive long enough to figure out why everyone in this world is trying to either kill him or marry him. He is not lucky enough for either.

Platforms: Gumroad · Kindle

entry.content:
A powerful figure, all might and all strength. Enters the castle, just walks through the gate. No monster too strong, no army too large. To Hero it is just another weak foe. He swings his mighty sword, all valiant with might. And collects all his harem from all in his sight. All women they serve him, all men they adore, and children to be him. They wish forevermore. The Hero is perfect. The Hero is grand. The Hero is perfect. Don't you understand? The Hero is coming, the Hero is here! The Hero was never late or on time. For time is a servant to Hero, oh mine! And then the Hero rides on his horse, slays all the monsters and saves us with force. His Harem is mighty, his power so great, that even the Princess obeys and is safe. This is the lullaby sung to the residents of the Toybox from the moment they are born. They live and breathe The Hero. He is perfect, he is kind, he is less a person and more a force of nature. There is just one tiny problem... "The Hero" has died countless times in the Toybox. He hates it, He hates them, He wants to escape more than anything. Except there is no escape. The Toybox runs on broken quests, worse incentives, and mechanics that should not exist. Then one day, during a random iteration like any other... One of the NPC's wake up... The Toybox will never be the same. She was written to serve, to adore, to worship. A perfect NPC in a perfect role. Never to awaken to the horrors of The Toybox. But she did... Now she's caught between what she was programmed to feel and what she actually feels. In a world built on broken mechanics, she might be the most broken of all. Content Warning: This story contains explicit sexual content, dubious consent that evolves into agency, psychological horror, existential themes, and meta commentary on game mechanics and player ethics. Features a sentient NPC navigating programmed desires vs. genuine choice. Dark romance with philosophical depth and a cathartic ending.

Platforms: Gumroad · Kindle

entry.content:
Tama is a Ninja. She speaks in the third person, loves her Sensei, and thinks her pet boar Jiggle is the best thing since burnt fish. She'd be perfectly happy fighting goblins, eating fries, and avoiding anything that sounds remotely like responsibility. Saki is a Kitsune. She's spent her entire life manipulating everyone around her, hiding her true nature, and ignoring the little voice in her head that whispers erase. She thought she was clever enough to control anyone and cynical enough to never truly need them. Then she met Tama. Together, the simple Nekojin and her dangerously clever Kitsune stumble from one catastrophe into the next, collecting friends, enemies, lovers, kingdoms, and occasionally entire religions along the way. Goblin armies, undead liches, ancient dragons, tyrannical empires, gods, and reality itself may stand in their path. But their greatest enemy remains undefeated: Responsibility.

Platforms: Gumroad · Kindle

entry.content:
Saki wanted revenge. She woke up in a goblin cage. After abandoning her friends in a moment of panic, Saki wakes captured, injured, and painfully aware of just how badly she screwed up. Then she discovers Tama is friends with the goblins. Unfortunately, there are bigger problems. The Lich Jabrome has murdered Tama’s Sensei, raised an army of the dead, and set his sights on Drestor. Now a goblin horde marches to meet him, and Saki may be the only person clever enough to keep everyone alive. But strategy is the easy part. To survive the coming war, Saki will have to face the people she failed, master the darkness whispering erase inside her mind, and confront enemies who may not be the monsters she thought they were. Revenge brought her this far. What comes next might require something much harder

Platforms: Gumroad · Kindle

The collars cannot be removed. Walking away would condemn them. A
entry.content:
Tama's worst nightmare has finally found her: responsibility. Separated from Saki and stranded in the ruined underwater city of Muosil, Tama rescues two women bound by blood collars only to discover that saving them was the easy part. The collars cannot be removed. Walking away would condemn them. And for once, Tama cannot simply run from the consequences. Elsewhere in the ruins, Saki awakens alone inside an ancient temple. Well... almost alone. A divine water spirit named Anna has attached herself to Saki and decided they should be best friends. Anna is ancient, absurdly powerful, capable of possessing nearly anyone at will, and has a rather flexible understanding of morality. When Tama and Saki finally reunite, escaping Muosil becomes the least of their problems. Between goblin politics, forgotten ruins, Anna's bloody past, and secrets surrounding Tama's royal heritage, both girls are being pushed toward responsibilities neither of them asked for. And some things buried beneath the water were never meant to stay forgotten.

Platforms: Gumroad · Kindle

entry.title: The Guardian - Volume 4
entry.summary: Tama can defeat almost anything. Unfortunately, you can't stab a coronation. After surviving the ancient ruins of Muosil, Tama and Saki return to Drestor expecting a moment of peace. Instead, Regent Alissa arrives with the royal guard and a demand Tama has spent her entire life trying to avoid: Take
entry.content:
Tama can defeat almost anything. Unfortunately, you can't stab a coronation. After surviving the ancient ruins of Muosil, Tama and Saki return to Drestor expecting a moment of peace. Instead, Regent Alissa arrives with the royal guard and a demand Tama has spent her entire life trying to avoid: Take the throne. Tama would rather fight goblins. Saki would rather find a clever way around the problem. Unfortunately, neither option is going to save them this time. While Tama is dragged toward a crown she never wanted, Saki discovers there is one battlefield all her schemes have left her completely unprepared for: love. Then Mantheria makes her move. The ancient dragon is powerful enough to brush Saki aside like nothing, old enough to remember secrets everyone else has forgotten, and far too interested in Tama's future. If Tama wants to protect her friends and survive what comes next, being the strongest ninja in the kingdom will not be enough. For once, she may have to become the one thing she never wanted to be. Queen.

Platforms: Gumroad · Kindle

entry.title: To Rule A Kingdom - Volume 5
entry.summary: Tama is about to become Queen. She would rather fight a dragon. Unfortunately, she may have to do both. The capital is preparing for a coronation. Tama is preparing to escape it. She is a ninja. Ninjas fight monsters, protect people, and eat fries. Queens apparently have meetings. Saki has the less
entry.content:
Tama is about to become Queen. She would rather fight a dragon. Unfortunately, she may have to do both. The capital is preparing for a coronation. Tama is preparing to escape it. She is a ninja. Ninjas fight monsters, protect people, and eat fries. Queens apparently have meetings. Saki has the less glamorous job of keeping the kingdom intact long enough to put a crown on Tama's head. A deadly plague is spreading through the capital. Powerful nobles are testing the future Queen. Foreign rulers are arriving with agendas of their own. And old enemies are beginning to crawl back into Tama's life. Then Manna returns. The ancient dragon still believes Tama is destined for greatness, and she has no intention of letting something as trivial as Tama's opinion get in the way. With the coronation approaching and everyone she loves being dragged into the chaos, Tama is running out of places to hide. She can fight monsters. She can fight dragons. She can even fight kings. But ruling a kingdom? That might finally be the battle she can't blink away from

Platforms: Kindle

entry.title: Fuyu The Hero - Volume 6
entry.summary: Her Majesty, Tamaneko is finally Queen. Unfortunately, the kingdom is still on fire. Saki is ready for a vacation. The universe disagrees. The plague is still spreading, the caldera is now visible to the outside world, and the mysterious Tamaneko Ward is hiding secrets even its new Queen does not un
entry.content:
Her Majesty, Tamaneko is finally Queen. Unfortunately, the kingdom is still on fire. Saki is ready for a vacation. The universe disagrees. The plague is still spreading, the caldera is now visible to the outside world, and the mysterious Tamaneko Ward is hiding secrets even its new Queen does not understand. Keeping the kingdom together would already be enough to ruin Saki's week. Then Manna comes back from the dead. The ancient dragon claims she can restore the Shrine of Creation and hide the caldera once more. There is only one problem: Manna still believes Tama is destined to become her Hero. Trusting her would be insane. Refusing her could leave the entire kingdom exposed. As Saki tries to protect a nation that has suddenly become much harder to hide, Tama is pulled deeper into the legacy of the Tamaneko family and a destiny she never asked for. Manna says she can save them. Do they really have a choice

Platforms: Kindle

entry.title: War on The Horizon - Volume 7
entry.summary: Tama has barely learned how to be Queen. Now she has to learn how to wage a war. After the restoration of the Shrine of Creation, Saki is finally trying to put her life back together. Naturally, that lasts about five minutes. More than a hundred armed ships appear on the horizon, approaching a kingd
entry.content:
Tama has barely learned how to be Queen. Now she has to learn how to wage a war. After the restoration of the Shrine of Creation, Saki is finally trying to put her life back together. Naturally, that lasts about five minutes. More than a hundred armed ships appear on the horizon, approaching a kingdom that has barely had time to recover. No one knows whether the fleet has come to negotiate, conquer, or simply decide the caldera belongs to someone else. After the usual meeting goes catastrophically off course, Tama and her friends capture one of the fleet’s officers. She is Aurelia, a princess of the empire. Saki quickly charms what information she can out of their new prisoner and discovers something much worse than an invasion fleet: This is only the beginning. Tama has only recently become Queen. Now an empire is looking toward her kingdom, an enemy princess may be their best source of information, and forces powerful enough to threaten even her strongest allies are moving closer. War is on the horizon. But really, what else is new for a Tamaneko

Platforms: Kindle

Armed with an obsessive mind, revolutionary rune concepts, and absolutely catastrophic social skill
entry.content:
Xanari Telis died proving humanity wrong. After creating the world’s first truly sentient artificial life, the brilliant young inventor awakens in Xanrea, a world of magic, monsters, and ancient gods. Armed with an obsessive mind, revolutionary rune concepts, and absolutely catastrophic social skills, Xan begins experimenting with magic the same way he once approached engineering. What starts as a simple attempt to create companionship quickly spirals into something far larger as Xan unintentionally overturns magical theory, terrifies priestesses, destabilizes economies, and lays the foundation for creations the world was never meant to possess. Accompanied by Tina, a Nekojin priestess rapidly losing control of her life, Xan journeys across Xanrea in search of knowledge, materials, and answers. But while kingdoms chase power and heroes fight monsters… Xan is quietly building something that may outlast them all.

Platforms: Kindle

entry.title: the Godling and Her Husband - Volume 1
entry.summary: My parents considered me an accident. But was useful as a tax write-off. Mommy served daddy and daddy beat her when she didn't listen. I was told that is how life was meant to be. That one day I would meet a man and I would be his perfect wife! When I was young, I started being able to see blue thin
entry.content:
My parents considered me an accident. But was useful as a tax write-off. Mommy served daddy and daddy beat her when she didn't listen. I was told that is how life was meant to be. That one day I would meet a man and I would be his perfect wife! When I was young, I started being able to see blue things inside people. I could reach out and take them or change them. When I took mommy's blue thing she fell down and stopped moving. I put it back and she got up. I realized when I did things to the blue thing, mommy started doing what I wanted. So I did the same to daddy, having mommy help me. Then I met Mark. I knew in an instant it was him, my perfect husband. There were a few.. small flaws. He was far too old, mommy told me that me being so young and him being that much older was wrong and people would be upset. I punished mommy for upsetting me. But she was right, she was mommy after all. So I did the only thing I could think of! I gave Mark my body! The nice policeman told mommy he died of a heart attack. but Mark was okay, he was with me! We were going to find him a new body that was even better then his old one and we would be married and I would be the perfect wife! At least... that was the plan. It's been fifteen years and Mark still hasn't chosen a body. He uses mine.

Platforms: Gumroad · Kindle
